data_vintage.source_note: Owner-supplied 2016-2025 county exports; source taxonomy release unknown.
data_vintage.missing_semantics: Missing row/value or zero support => null; suspicious 0.0015/noninteger cells retained raw but excluded from numeric ranking

taxonomy.source_taxonomy_note: Annual export bodies do not embed a release; scope is owner-supplied filename/context.

regional_method.method: checklist-sample weighted mean of available county-bin frequencies
regional_method.support_meaning: sum of county-bin checklist samples; not a count of independent birding events
regional_method.missing_policy: null frequencies and zero-support bins are excluded from the weighted mean; null is not absence
regional_method.calendar: 48 native eBird calendar bins, retained exactly; 2001 is a non-leap display template

limitations: Automated acceptance is preliminary source/model corroboration, not biological certification.
Historical reporting frequency is not encounter probability or abundance.
Missing media coverage is explicit; no weak examples are promoted to fill a species.
Source taxonomy release is unknown; unresolved/split-lump names remain excluded.
Annual profiles are aggregated 2016–2025 reporting fractions, not year-by-year population trends.
Historical reporting frequency is not abundance, encounter probability or a recent-sighting count.
Missing values and zero-support bins remain distinct from observed zero reporting.
Unresolved, non-species and split/lump-ambiguous source names remain excluded.
